items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 23th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 89 while the rest average 31 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 89/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: The base is sitting tighter than usual
items.detail: Liveliness 0.611 is 2.1σ down vs its month. Rising = old coins moving (distribution/rotation); falling = holders sitting still (accumulation).
items.framing: Coins are sitting tighter — liveliness fell. The base is holding, dormancy deepening.
items.checkable: Coin-days-destroyed vs coin-days-stored from the FIFO reconstruction.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-15.1% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 6.96M SPX. 4w -13.2% · 12w -15.1% · 26w -22.5%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-15.1% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: 1 new proven top-timer in 90 days
items.detail: Wallet(s) that just crossed the ROI+capital bar by selling a top at profit — a burst means distribution is starting.
items.framing: 1 wallet(s) newly qualified as smart money in 90d (sold a top at ≥5× ROI). Low count = quiet market; a spike is the tell.
items.checkable: First crossing of the ROI+capital bar per wallet, from the sale history.

items.headline: A 1.77M-SPX holder moved everything to a new wallet of its own
items.detail: 2026-09-26 (2d ago). A test send, a test sent back, then the whole balance — the coins keep their age and cost, so it is not a sale and books no profit or loss.
items.framing: A 1.77M SPX position changed wallets on 2026-09-26: same holder, new address. Say "moved to a new wallet", never "sold" or "exited".
items.checkable: The handshake (small send, small send back, then the balance) is in the raw transfer history; both wallets are linked below.

items.headline: A whale added 772k SPX in 7 days
items.detail: 0xc044…d859 accumulated over the window, one of 3 whales net-buying.
items.framing: A large wallet accumulated 772k SPX in 7 days. Real, checkable buying by a big holder.
items.checkable: Net balance change on a watched wallet over the last week of transfers.

items.headline: One wallet scooped 5 AEON in a single day
items.detail: 0xb744…337d is the biggest net buyer of Project AEON over 30 days — 2.3 ETH ($6,230), well clear of the field.
items.framing: One wallet accumulated 5 AEON (~$6,230) on the market. Show the tornado / the city arcs — anyone can verify it.
items.checkable: Net marketplace buys minus sells per wallet over 30 days, from the public sale log.

items.headline: 3.94M SPX left in a day at a loss
items.detail: 2026-09-26: 35 wallets dropped below the 5k bar with 3.94M SPX, 2.3σ above the usual churn — loss-led (capitulation).
items.framing: A loss-led exit wave — the worrying kind: 35 wallets left 3.94M SPX underwater. Say "left/dropped below the bar", not "dumped".
items.checkable: Wallets whose balance fell below the 5k residency bar that day, split by exit vs entry price.

items.headline: Valuation: 23th percentile — Undervalued
items.detail: The composite (six lenses on one 0–100 scale) reads 23 of its own history — undervalued.
items.framing: SPX reads undervalued today — 23th percentile of its own history. The one-line state of play.
items.checkable: Weighted percentile of six independent valuation lenses; weights published on Methods.

items.headline: Price is 0.85× the crowd's cost basis
items.detail: Spot $0.425 vs realized price $0.499 — the average holder is underwater (MVRV 0.85).
items.framing: Holders sit below their aggregate cost basis (MVRV 0.85). Historically an accumulation zone.
items.checkable: Market cap ÷ realized cap, from the FIFO cost-basis reconstruction.

items.headline: 51% of supply is in profit
items.detail: 51% of tracked supply is held above its on-chain cost basis today.
items.framing: 51% of supply is in profit. Low = capitulation zone, high = euphoria risk; a position read, not a signal.
items.checkable: Held coins with cost basis below spot, from the FIFO engine.

items.headline: 49,064 ETH holders — held flat over 30 days
items.detail: The ETH holder base is 49,064, held flat +0.3% over the last 30 days.
items.framing: Holder base held flat (+0.3% in 30d). Adoption trend, decoupled from price.
items.checkable: Distinct ETH addresses holding a balance, from the transfer history.

items.headline: 63% of supply held over a year
items.detail: 63% of tracked supply hasn't moved in 12 months — the diamond base.
items.framing: 63% of supply is 1y+ held. Deep conviction base; compare to Bitcoin at the same age.
